claims.text: FDA-approved oral once-daily tx for non-CF bronchiectasis (NCFB), age ≥12; the first and only FDA-approved NCFB tx.
claims.quote: the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved first-in-class BRINSUPRI™ (brensocatib 10 mg and 25 mg tablets), an oral, once-daily treatment for non-cystic fibrosis bronchiectasis (NCFB) in adults and children 12 years and older. BRINSUPRI is the first and only FDA-approved treatment for NCFB
